units.passage: Comply with third-party intellectual property rights: YU faculty and staff must not represent any output generated by Generative AI tools as their own.
units.why: "must not represent any output generated by Generative AI tools as their own" bans passing off AI output; no type covers this staff-facing authorship rule, so UNCOVERED.
units.fit_note: Concerns faculty and staff work, and is about representing output as own rather than submitting it.
units.uncovered_note: Faculty and staff must not present AI-generated output as their own work.
